item.title: Spicy Saturday food deals return to Grand Rapids Downtown Market
item.description: Beginning Feb. 7, visitors to the Grand Rapids Downtown Market each Saturday can enjoy the return of Spicy Saturdays and specialty products from over 20 different vendors.

item.title: Man convicted of attempted murder in Kalamazoo shooting that injured 4
item.description: A man has been convicted of a slew of charges stemming from a December 2024 shooting in Kalamazoo that injured four people.

item.title: Snowy, narrow streets challenge Grand Rapids trash truck drivers
item.description: In Grand Rapids, narrow streets and snow-packed curbs are turning sanitation workers' routine pickups into a daily challenge.

item.title: Rewards offered as search for Savannah Guthrie's mother continues: Here's the latest
item.description: Law enforcement officials are still desperately searching for leads in the investigation into the disappearance of 84-year-old Nancy Guthrie, the mother of NBC News's “Today” show co-anchor Savannah Guthrie.

item.title: Bad Bunny or Kid Rock? Halftime is the Super Bowl's hot-button issue
item.description: There has been a lot of discussion about the Super Bowl halftime show, which will feature Grammy Award-winning artist Bad Bunny.

item.title: Tigers and pitcher Framber Valdez agree to $115 million, 3-year deal, AP source says
item.description: Free agent pitcher Framber Valdez and the Detroit Tigers have agreed to a $115 million, three-year contract, a person familiar with the situation told The Associated Press on Wednesday night. The person spoke to the AP on condition of anonymity because the deal had not been announced. Valdez became one of baseball’s most durable starters [...]

item.title: Mattawan bus driver fired for passing out candy claims religious discrimination
item.description: A former Mattawan bus driver is suing the school district, alleging that she was wrongfully terminated after passing out holiday candy bags to students on her bus, some of which contained religious messages.

item.title: Denny's restaurants close in Grand Rapids and Kalamazoo
item.description: Two West Michigan Denny's locations appear to be closed.

item.title: 'Please reach out to us': Savannah Guthrie, family post Instagram message to potential kidnapper
item.description: "Today" show co-host Savannah Guthrie and her two siblings posted a video Wednesday on Instagram directly addressing whomever might have their mother, and pleading for her safe return.

item.title: 'It just seems like the right time,' GRPD's Winstrom says of move to Florida
item.description: Grand Rapids Police Chief Eric Winstrom has introduced himself to the community in Pensacola, Florida, where he has just been named the city's next police chief. After four years with the Grand Rapids Police Department, he said it "just seems like the right time" to leave.
